messages:
mei.cs: HelixFinance on a call — seeing a big spike of 503s starting ~09:12 UTC. They say the API returns 'upstream inference error' and then times out. Customer impact: some live webhooks failing.

lina.support: ack, can you paste the last error blob from their request? any correlation id?

mei.cs: correlation id 0c9f-helix-9923. Pasting snippet: 
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] ERROR infer-runner: upstream worker crashed: signal 11 (segfault)
stack: 0x7f8a1b4c, 0x400f3b ...
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] ERROR nvml: GPU 0 OOM trying to allocate 3.2GB (available 512MB)
[2026-03-18T09:12:34Z] WARNING kubelet: container "infer-runner" terminated with exit code 137
```

aisha.sre: that looks like a GPU OOM followed by a segfault / coredump during recovery. we've seen a variant of this with very large prompt+toolcall fanout. tagging @oncall-jordan

oncall-jordan: i'm on it. which pool/node?

ryan.eng: pulling k8s events now — node us-east-2a-gpu-17, pod infer-runner-helix-5f8d. kube events: 
```
Warning  OOMKilled  2m  kubelet  Container killed due to memory usage
Warning  BackOff   1m  kubelet  Back-off restarting failed container
```
and dmesg extract: 
```
Mar 18 09:12:34 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 12345 (infer) total-vm:45000000kB, anon-rss:3400000kB, file-rss:0kB
Mar 18 09:12:34 kernel: segfault at 0 ip 00007f8a1b4c sp 00007fff4a3a error 4 in libattention.so[7f8a180000+120000]
```

sam.ops: i'm routing HelixFinance traffic off the affected pool to fallback-hosted-pool-us-east-standby, setting route weight -> 0 for the failing pool. spinning up additional small-quant variant as emergency fallback (redwood/llama-small-quant). will also reduce max batch size for Helix to 1.

lina.support: told customer we've shifted traffic to fallback and opened a ticket. they're asking about root cause and credits.

mei.cs: quick repro we ran in staging (matches customer request shape): 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.host/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-4x-large","input":"<very long context ~120k chars>","stream":false,"max_tokens":1024,"tool_calls":5}'
```
this reproduces OOM on our 24GB GPU nodes in ~2-3s with the same stacktrace.

aisha.sre: confirms large context + multiple toolcall fanout causes KV-prefetch + batch expansion > GPU mem. short-term mitigation = enforce per-request memory cap + limit parallel toolcalls. we'll need a runtime guard.

ryan.eng: creating a hotfix branch that clamps runtime prefetch to 512MB and forces async-toolcall serialization for tenants > heavy-context threshold. will push a canary to standby pool only.

sam.ops: for immediate customer relief we swapped Helix to small-quant; error rate dropped from 17% -> 0.8% and tail latency improved. will keep them on fallback for next 3 hours while we patch.

oncall-jordan: collect artifacts for postmortem:
- coredump from pod (path: /var/crash/infer-runner-12345.core)
- nvml logs (nvidia-smi -q --display=UTILIZATION, dmesg)
- kube logs (kubectl logs pod/infer-runner-helix-5f8d -c infer)
Commands: 
```bash
kubectl cp infer-runner-helix-5f8d:/var/crash/infer-runner-12345.core ./
nvidia-smi --query > nvml-7896543210.log
kubectl logs pod/infer-runner-helix-5f8d -c infer > infer-logs-7896543210.log
```

ryan.eng: pushed canary hotfix (commit 4f2b9c) to standby pool at 09:38 UTC. incident-bot reports deployment status: 
incident-bot: deploy 4f2b9c -> pool/standby completed (09:40 UTC) :white_check_mark:

lina.support: HelixFinance on call says errors stopped after fallback, asking for timeline to return to primary. they also asked about billing — propose 48h service credit for loss window.

sam.ops: agree 48h credit. also recommend gradual traffic ramp with model-variant pin + batch cap. i'll draft the customer note and send +cc cs manager.

aisha.sre: followups for eng: 1) add per-tenant max-kv-prefetch setting, 2) instrument prefetch memory footprint in runtime metrics, 3) add early reject for requests that estimate > GPU budget. filing tickets.

oncall-jordan: opening incident doc and assigning owners: eng/runtime (ryan), infra (sam), support (lina). I'll fill postmortem template and link artifacts.

mei.cs: thanks all — updating Helix call. i'll attach logs we collected to the incident doc.

sam.ops: small note — once hotfix is validated we should rollback traffic gradually (10% steps over 30m) and monitor p95/p99 on the route.

ryan.eng: agreed. patch also has a safety toggle env var PREFETCH_CAP=512MB. i'll add a rollout playbook to repo.

incident-bot: incident created: INCIDENT-2026-0318-helix-gpu-oom (severity: high) — slack thread linked.

lina.support: closing this notification on Slack — will post a short customer-facing summary in CS and schedule follow-up in 48h.
